PROPOSED at P0 for advisor review before P1. formScenarios (P1-a, reviewed): every scenario whose order is placed through the REAL order form (PLAN §2: S1 / S1t / S1a / S2 / S3 / S4 / S13 and P2's S5 / S11); S14 (unsupported methods through the real HANDLER) and S17 (no form for the synthetic brand) are not.

S1t-a.variant: first strike: A never accepts → reassigned to B (attempts 2, A cooldown) → B delivers

S1t-b.variant: second strike: B never accepts either → unassigned + no_response_takeover alert → manual assign → delivered

S1t-c.variant: only A eligible → no_drivers_available → unassigned → manual assign → delivered

S1a-on.variant: config/auto_assign_enabled = true: advance(GRACE) → the auto-assigner assigns

S1a-off.variant: config/auto_assign_enabled = false: advance(GRACE) is a NO-OP (still unassigned)

unsitedFacts._doc: codex r3 P1-3 — a PLAN fact of an R-site with NO census site (the census covers persisted-ORDER field reads). Each such (R, fact) group is dispositioned here, never silently joined: 'output' = the surface shows the fact through a path the census does not attribute (named outputs, file#fn, each checked to exist); 'not-in-source' = the PLAN lists the fact but the named outputs do NOT display it (a PLAN-vs-source finding: the cell asserts the fact's ABSENCE from those outputs until the PLAN table is reconciled). Every site-less group with cells must appear here; an entry for a group that HAS sites is stale (RED). A disposition may SPLIT ({split: [{when: {fulfil?, scenarios?, lps?}, kind, outputs, reason}]}); every cell must match exactly one part. 'not-in-source' cells get their own kind (reported apart from agreement, listed in matrix.json planReconciliation) and must be reconciled with the PLAN by an advisor ruling before P1 executes the matrix. Every 'not-in-source' part must carry the advisor's `ruling` (the PLAN fact's reconciliation) — a part without one is a build problem (P1 precondition).

siteApplicability._doc: codex r3 P1-3 — every site obligation APPLIES, by default, to EVERY cell of its (R, fact) group (all its scenarios × brands × LPs): each such (cell, site) pair is an obligation. Narrowing is ONLY by a reviewed entry here: {site (exact census id), fact, scenarios?, brands?, lps?, reason}. An entry that matches no obligation, has no reason, or leaves the site no REQUIRED cell is RED. Empty at P0 (no narrowing reviewed yet).

absenceOutputs._doc: codex r4 P1-3 — the designated assertion of an ABSENCE cell: the reviewed output(s) that must NOT show the order at that LP (each checked to exist). coverage() requires every required absence cell's assertions to execute, like any other required cell.

displayCells._doc: codex P1 plan r1 P1-7 / approved §1 'Envío Gratis': DISPLAY cells (kind display; counted separately). X Pizza's form shows the free-delivery promo row ("Envío Gratis", L70 struck through) for DELIVERY and NOT for pickup; L70 is never part of the payable total (an oracle MONEY relationship). La Musa has no such row. P1-a review: the PAY STEP (R14) does not call freeDeliveryRowHTML — renderStage2Summary prints its own 'Envío / Gratis' row — so R14's output is renderStage2Summary (the cart sheet R13 is freeDeliveryRowHTML's only consumer).

brandSurfaces._doc: P1-a (reviewed): a brand's OWN surface — code that is physically that brand's site — applies only to that brand's cells. Shared surfaces (KDS, dispatch, driver, dashboard, tracker, functions) apply to every brand. A site or an unsited output under one of these path prefixes joins only cells of the listed brands.
